title_zh: 云岭大地各族干部群众集中收听收看中国共产党成立105周年庆祝大会盛况
title_en: Yunnan People Watch Live Broadcast of CPC's 105th Anniversary Celebration
summary_zh: 2026年7月2日，云南各族干部群众集中收听收看中国共产党成立105周年庆祝大会盛况。
summary_en: On July 2, 2026, people of all ethnic groups in Yunnan gathered to watch the live broadcast of the grand celebration of the 105th anniversary of the Communist Party of China.
